step.name: call_pickup_place
step.content: {"order":"CD-420578","goal":"Find out if the signed release document for the Bentley is received at werkstatt@calverona.example, who the named storekeeper is for Fri 23 Oct 10:00-13:00, and what exactly they need and by when.","language":"de"}

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Calverona Hamburg, Werkstatt, Lukas Brandt am Apparat. Was kann ich für Sie tun?
turns.translation: Calverona Hamburg, workshop, Lukas Brandt speaking. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Guten Tag Herr Brandt, hier ist der digitale Assistent von Bahn. Ich rufe wegen des Bentley Continental GT, Auftrag CD-420578, für Freitag, den 23. Oktober, zwischen 10 und 13 Uhr an: Ist die unterschriebene Freigabe schon bei werkstatt@calverona.example eingegangen?
turns.translation: Good day Mr. Brandt, this is Bahn's digital assistant. I'm calling about the Bentley Continental GT, order CD-420578, for Friday, 23 October, between 10 and 13: has the signed release already arrived at werkstatt@calverona.example?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Nein, für den Bentley haben wir noch keine Freigabe. Ohne die gibt der Lagerist die Schlüssel nicht heraus, sie muss unterschrieben per E-Mail an werkstatt@calverona.example gehen.
turns.translation: No, we don't have a release for the Bentley yet. Without it the storekeeper won't hand over the keys; it has to be sent signed by e-mail to werkstatt@calverona.example.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Verstanden, die Freigabe ist noch nicht da. Wie heißt denn der Lagerist, der am Freitag zwischen 10 und 13 Uhr zuständig ist, und bis wann muss die Freigabe bei Ihnen sein?
turns.translation: Understood, the release hasn't arrived yet. What is the name of the storekeeper who is responsible on Friday between 10 and 13, and by when does the release need to be with you?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Den Namen des Lagerists und eine Frist müsste ich erst nachprüfen, das weiß ich gerade nicht. Wichtig ist, dass die unterschriebene Freigabe vor der Abholung per E-Mail bei uns ankommt.
turns.translation: I would have to check the storekeeper's name and any deadline, I don't know that right now. What matters is that the signed release arrives by e-mail before the collection.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alles klar. Bitte schicken Sie uns den Namen des Lagerlisten und die Frist per E-Mail an Bahn, dann gebe ich es weiter. Ich fasse zusammen: Die unterschriebene Freigabe fehlt noch und muss vor der Abholung per E-Mail bei Ihnen eingehen. Vielen Dank, Herr Brandt, auf Wiederhören!
turns.translation: Alright. Please send us the storekeeper's name and the deadline by email to Bahn, and I will pass it on. To summarize: the signed release is still missing and must arrive by email before pickup. Thank you, Mr. Brandt, goodbye!

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Gern, ich gebe das intern weiter. Auf Wiederhören!
turns.translation: Gladly, I'll pass that on internally. Goodbye!

I've brought a person one decision: ask the customer for the release, with a Danish draft. The pickup place didn't know the storekeeper's name or a deadline, so I'll ask again in a callback on Thu 22 Oct at 08:00 UTC.

Delivery contact on the order: Grace Lumenmere, handoff contact (contact unconfirmed).
No driver is booked and the gig is not published to drivers.

Calverona Hamburg rule at handover: Check signed release authority and driver ID before handover.

Learned from Aino's decision on 21 Oct: Calverona Hamburg won't hand over a car under a seller hold without the seller's signed release emailed to werkstatt@calverona.example. Before pickup day, confirm the branch has it; send no driver until then.
CMR on the order: prepared, required, no file.
No release document is on the order, and Calverona Hamburg needs a signed one before the car leaves.
Selected pickup slot: Fri 23 Oct 10:00 to 13:00 (Berlin time), set by Bahn ops.
Customer delivery promise: Mon 26 Oct 12:00 to 16:00 (Copenhagen time), set by Bahn ops.
The pickup place has not received a release document for the Bentley yet.
Without the release document the storekeeper will not hand over the keys.
The release document must be sent signed by e-mail to werkstatt@calverona.example.
The pickup place does not know right now the storekeeper's name or any deadline and would have to check.
The signed release document must arrive by e-mail before the collection.
The pickup place will pass on internally the request to send the storekeeper's name and deadline.
No driver is booked, so nothing needs to be held or released now. The release document is the open item, and the slot is in about 47 hours.
The storekeeper's name and any deadline are still unknown. The pickup place only said the release must arrive before collection.
